stage0041_03:r_1c0f94acd5a8a143.text: ～ $$聖天使学園$$, $$シュレード$$'s Room ～

stage0041_03:r_1263541f4071624e.text:
$$シュレード$$
「...Rare of you, old friend,
　to come visit my room」

stage0041_03:r_7ab28e70b4d4f641.text:
$$カイエン$$
「...Lately, I've been having
　nightmares again...」

stage0041_03:r_b05f6a6e8f3d9b24.text:
$$シュレード$$
「That wedding in mourning clothes again?」

stage0041_03:r_0abcaf0c31978670.text:
$$シュレード$$
「A one-eyed giant...?
　I wonder what that could mean...」

stage0041_03:r_1d6bc48b7f246730.text:
$$カイエン$$
「If I knew that, I wouldn't be struggling」

stage0041_03:r_f951916061232dcd.text:
$$カイエン$$
「Do you have any idea what it means?」

stage0041_03:r_4d863c3fb88a4c39.text:
$$シュレード$$
「These past few days, an odd noise has been bugging me」

stage0041_03:r_9e701cdeb3842c21.text:
$$シュレード$$
「A small noise crept in near us these past days...
　It might connect to your nightmares somehow」

stage0041_03:r_6fd81f4abebe60c5.text:
$$カイエン$$
「This strangeness, the past few days...
　No, it can't be...」

stage0041_03:r_09d0fcc600cdd3df.text:
$$ユノハ$$
「$$ジン$$... why are we touring NERV?」

stage0041_03:r_182faded068c15ed.text:
$$ジン$$
「I got curious about the red sea story $$シンジ$$ told me」

stage0041_03:r_9c206d19bfda4bd5.text:
$$ジン$$
（It's not me who's curious, it's $$ミカゲ$$...）

stage0041_03:r_6e558bc69acf5bf3.text:
$$ユノハ$$
「$$シンジ$$ and $$ミサト$$ were supposed
　to show us around, but
　they don't seem to have come」

stage0041_03:r_d60d0818e965232f.text:
$$ジン$$
「$$シンジ$$'s one thing, but
　$$ミサト$$'s always late」

stage0041_03:r_43e4e548c0b28376.text:
$$ユノハ$$
「It's been a week since $$ジン$$ transferred...
　Seems like you're used to $c already」

stage0041_03:r_708bea61e3c43ada.text:
$$ユノハ$$
「I'm... going to go see if $$シンジ$$
　and the others have arrived」

stage0041_03:r_7b6f159eeaf4de0f.text:
$$ジン$$
（$$ユノハ・スルール$$...
　Somehow, being with her feels strange...）

stage0041_03:r_0827963cfd706e8d.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Good work, $$ジン$$...
　Infiltrating NERV seems to be going well」

stage0041_03:r_3f4035fd9db81258.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「No need to be so surprised.
　You know as well as I do that crossing
　the wall of dimensions is nothing to me」

stage0041_03:r_567b361a454c4b73.text:
$$ジン$$
「...What do you want, $$ミカゲ$$?
　Not using the comm means this is
　something secret from $$イズモ$$, right?」

stage0041_03:r_d22851aaafbbf8fc.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「You're a clever one, aren't you.
　That's exactly right」

stage0041_03:r_352534f64413d954.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「I'm about to send information directly
　into your brain now. That's my request」

stage0041_03:r_79f2664edb1af798.text:
$$ジン$$
「Wait a second.
　I never said I'd take this on...」

stage0041_03:r_a62c4e7f3c09f7ed.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「You're not allowed to refuse.
　This is the key to Altair's future.」

stage0041_03:r_53bb64ee17750ee2.text:
$$ジン$$
（Something like that exists inside NERV...!?）

stage0041_03:r_2103f6df2ea2e447.text:
$$シンジ$$
「Welcome to $$第３新東京市$$.
　NERV Headquarters is right here」

stage0041_03:r_a12e3e130d896ff7.text:
$$ジン$$
「So $$シンジ$$'s dad is NERV's supreme commander,
　the one who built that EVA, huh?」

stage0041_03:r_91bf33c27ad39f0a.text:
$$ジン$$
「...Do you know about the 'Book of Genesis'?」

stage0041_03:r_ce1b55e526b6277a.text:
$$ジン$$
「I heard it's some document NERV has」

stage0041_03:r_c304df6888eb78f7.text:
$$シンジ$$
「Why do you know about NERV, $$ジン$$...?」

stage0041_03:r_c26958634526e597.text:
$$ジン$$
「Before I came to $c,
　I heard it at the Element academy」

stage0041_03:r_cdb750c9d380881a.text:
$$ジン$$
「It just sounded like such a big name.
　I got curious」

stage0041_03:r_95fda74613c97b39.text:
$$シンジ$$
「Sorry...
　I've never heard of it」

stage0041_03:r_48f49f6728c15612.text:
$$ジン$$
（If it's come to this, I'll infiltrate NERV
　and hack their data from the inside）

stage0041_03:r_0ebc5a6f1e0f81bf.text:
$$ミサト$$
「Sorry, sorry, everyone!
　Guess I'm running a bit late!」

stage0041_03:r_f02c37d91387d0ad.text:
$$ジン$$
「A bit...?
　Is a 30-minute delay just 'a bit'
　here at NERV?」

stage0041_03:r_6bbd5a3c5afb87e0.text:
$$ミサト$$
「Really, sorry.
　Things got hectic right before I left」

stage0041_03:r_32eb462c1b4999cb.text:
$$ミサト$$
「Look forward to it, $$シンジ$$.
　You're going to be surprised」

stage0041_03:r_4740e748fae085ee.text:
$$ミサト$$
「Alright then, $$ジン$$, $$ユノハ$$...
　let me show you around NERV」

stage0041_03:r_b76524cd840e1d37.text:
$$ミサト$$
「But follow my orders exactly in here,
　or they're cleared to open fire」

stage0041_03:r_ffe0fca26da5cd38.text:
$$ジン$$
「So it's shoot first, no questions...
　Rough joke, that」

stage0041_03:r_bfb27f9eb2f7073e.text:
$$ミサト$$
「Just so you know, I'm serious」

stage0041_03:r_4b0e43ba6a5f2f5b.text:
$$ユノハ$$
「The Geofront is amazing, $$ミサト$$.
　I'm surprised there's a place like this underground」

stage0041_03:r_6a74519e1fc29c4b.text:
$$ミサト$$
「This city was built to intercept Angels.
　Though since we're up against Angels,
　no amount of prep is ever truly enough」

stage0041_03:r_5b992878fee054b5.text:
$$ミサト$$
「By the way, $$ユノハ$$...
　What do you think of $$ジン$$?」

stage0041_03:r_4a14ec0c511c7f0d.text:
$$ユノハ$$
「...I think he's a good person...」

stage0041_03:r_b591d812c96c6c99.text:
$$ミサト$$
（She and $$シンジ$$ don't seem to suspect a thing...
　In this state, I can't act on
　$$カイエン$$'s report alone...）

stage0041_03:r_e350fa099c1ab072.text:
$$ミサト$$
（I hope it's just his worrying too much...）

stage0041_03:r_fb05d8e5f1ee93e5.text:
$$ユノハ$$
「...$$ジン$$ and $$シンジ$$... they're slow」

stage0041_03:r_c33bd700553abf91.text:
$$ミサト$$
「Boys, touching up makeup in the bathroom?」

stage0041_03:r_feee5c91826230e1.text:
$$ユノハ$$
「Does touching up makeup take this long?」

stage0041_03:r_bccc48e1964ad22d.text:
$$ミサト$$
（Ugh... a bare-faced girl like her wouldn't
　get the struggles of late-twenties women...）

stage0041_03:r_3599f0a4343fd95c.text:
$$シンジ$$
「He left the bathroom before I did,
　but he's still not back...?」

stage0041_03:r_3bc7834a5bf3ee76.text:
$$ミサト$$
「Damn...! I was too soft on him!」

stage0041_03:r_5b7ee307a700171a.text:
$$ジン$$
（So they've noticed already...
　$$葛城ミサト$$... seems she was on to me）

stage0041_03:r_8d8f065c932da30a.text:
$$ジン$$
（But it's too late now.
　Once I have the 'Book of Genesis' data,
　it's as good as mine）

stage0041_03:r_adec86483b13599a.text:
$$カヲル$$
「Doesn't matter who I am.
　I just don't intend to overlook
　anything that would make him sad」

stage0041_03:r_f527e012803f7f1c.text:
$$カヲル$$
「Give it up.
　That's more than you can handle」

stage0041_03:r_338f3b27e51dcc41.text:
$$ミサト$$
「Hands up!
　Move and I'll shoot!」

stage0041_03:r_0c8ea89b07432421.text:
$$ミサト$$
「I warned you!
　Don't hold it against me!」

stage0041_03:r_be100a32b731708d.text:
$$ミサト$$
「Get out of the way, $$ユノハ$$!!」

stage0041_03:r_66d4ae3a21caf881.text:
$$ユノハ$$
「Amazing, $$ジン$$!
　Your Element ability's awakened!」

stage0041_03:r_63249745ffae61b6.text:
$$ミサト$$
「Don't move!
　This close, that A.T. Field knockoff
　shouldn't work!」

stage0041_03:r_3ff2e21207d1d1d3.text:
$$シンジ$$
「Please wait, $$ミサト$$!
　$$ジン$$ just got lost, that's all!」

stage0041_03:r_e51ecf6d6aa42e75.text:
$$ミサト$$
「That's my call to make!
　He's being held for now!」

stage0041_03:r_ec1a06a7023bf72c.text:
$$マコト$$
「Colonel Katsuragi!
　Please come to the Command Center right away!」

stage0041_03:r_8805f96e52aaa462.text:
$$マコト$$
「An Angel's appeared over the Pacific!」

stage0041_03:r_7cbc63dad295f862.text:
$$冬月$$
「We judged that he simply got lost.
　In fact, there's no sign he interfered
　with NERV HQ, including MAGI access.」

stage0041_03:r_2d09c6f6a2d990ea.text:
$$ゲンドウ$$
「Are you dissatisfied, Colonel Katsuragi?」

stage0041_03:r_3c5fcfc484a51913.text:
$$ミサト$$
「No...
　If that's the Commander's judgment,
　I have no objection.」

stage0041_03:r_0476ffd10c764b0e.text:
$$ジン$$
「So I can go back to $c, then?」

stage0041_03:r_48c6c1ecfea6fe4a.text:
$$ミサト$$
「...$$ジン$$, let me say just one thing.」

stage0041_03:r_2b3479c4cf0680f4.text:
$$ジン$$
「I don't need an apology.
　It's true I did something suspicious.」

stage0041_03:r_e370696b8936b08c.text:
$$ミサト$$
「Just this much: don't ever betray
　the people who believe in you.」

stage0041_03:r_9af213fc64e0afec.text:
$$ミサト$$
「Don't you dare say there are none.」

stage0041_03:r_0c705091f748360e.text:
$$ミサト$$
「Then I'll take him and
　head back to $c.」

stage0041_03:r_817b2773b4ed563e.text:
$$ゲンドウ$$
「It's a fact that he did nothing.
　So we merely observe him as an uncertain variable.」

stage0041_03:r_1cc233cbc8c80af7.text:
$$冬月$$
「But since he made this his target,
　caution is still warranted.」

stage0041_03:r_3ce2f3e58cfdc3ba.text:
$$ゲンドウ$$
「The $$第７の使徒$$'s appearance, Unit-02 joining...
　and now, an irregular presence...」

stage0041_03:r_e180b22d18f48d38.text:
$$ゲンドウ$$
「Perhaps it's all a necessary piece
　steering us toward a fated end...」

stage0041_03:r_23a9c7ab620ab112.text: ～ Municipal Junior High School No. 1 Classroom ～

stage0041_03:r_d73c21f119847e35.text:
$$トウジ$$
「Cut it out already, $$ジン$$!
　$$シンジ$$'s been worried about you...!」

stage0041_03:r_89766f5ffaa912d4.text:
$$シンジ$$
「It's fine.
　You're back now, $$ジン$$, that's enough.」

stage0041_03:r_451f726d4299ea35.text:
$$シンジ$$
「Can I ask you something instead?
　$$ジン$$, did you ask to tour NERV
　just to spy on us?」

stage0041_03:r_2ddff5064af78db4.text:
$$シンジ$$
「Besides, $$ジン$$, your Element ability awoke,
　and you tried to protect $$ユノハ$$ above all.」

stage0041_03:r_d583fcea31bdad2e.text:
$$アスカ$$
「Are you stupid?
　If this guy were a spy, he's hardly
　going to say 'yes, that's right'!」

stage0041_03:r_f228ae702350849b.text:
$$扇$$
「Let me introduce her properly.
　Transferring to this school as of today,
　$$式波・アスカ・ラングレー$$.」

stage0041_03:r_3c3735172a480b72.text:
$$アスカ$$
「No need for that.
　I'll do things my own way.」

stage0041_03:r_1f418b5594cea300.text:
$$アスカ$$
「Just because we're in the same unit
　doesn't mean you can get familiar with me.」

stage0041_03:r_79c90de32a79212d.text:
$$トウジ$$
「Weird transfer students just keep coming...」

stage0041_03:r_33f7fd55913419e8.text:
$$ケンスケ$$
「This one... I smell a storm coming.」

stage0041_03:r_473d9a88b4ca96e7.text:
$$シンジ$$
（$$式波・アスカ・ラングレー$$... huh...）

stage0041_03:r_4fb296e63cb1fb46.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well done, Master $$シンジ$$.
　Striking the enemy's core forces, what
　a splendid feat, I'm moved myself!」

stage0041_03:r_9dc59affd40f32fc.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Ah, that naive smile of yours...!
　Master $$シンジ$$, you probably don't
　realize it, but you're quite the charmer!」

stage0041_03:r_d36072babd12aeb4.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Your feats in today's battle got me
　so excited, I ended up generating
　a Z-Chip myself, without meaning to!」

stage0041_03:r_09ee921a85025fd3.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「The amount... a full 100 Z!
　I'll add it to the squad's stock.」

stage0041_03:r_fae689f2a1057b61.text:
$$シンジ$$
「So Z-Chips can come from
　a robot's feelings too.」

stage0041_03:r_91c6d0bb53854ecc.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Naturally.
　After all, I'm top of the line among
　the agent robots $$ＤＥＭ$$ has developed.」

stage0041_03:r_42a3149105314ab8.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I won't lose even to Master $$モーム$$,
　who has a heart in love.」

stage0041_03:r_62ecd978c667bd29.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「When it comes to expressing emotion,
　I'm confident I best Master $$キリコ$$,
　Lady Ayanami, and Master $$トロワ$$.」

stage0041_03:r_b2aab8873350ea1f.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「After all, Lady Ayanami is an iron maiden
　unshaken even by a direct touch.」

stage0041_03:r_2c7af4c55d8ac938.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well, Master $$シンジ$$, who got slapped by
　that very Lady Ayanami, is more fearsome still.」

stage0041_03:r_653b741d07545dff.text:
$$シンジ$$
「How do you know about that...!?」

stage0041_03:r_d584d4b5af55b1cf.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well, that's just...
　a dimensional trader's basic decorum, shall we say.」

stage0041_03:r_a8118b2e37aa1382.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Oh my, my...!
　I always thought I was quite humble...」

stage0041_03:r_017a56991b7b8ca4.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Ah, being humble doesn't mean
　I'm proud of having short legs, though.」

stage0041_03:r_ad3e1db3419665fb.text:
$$アスカ$$
「Fine, I'll spell it out for you.
　Politely or not, I don't like being
　called by name by someone I barely know.」

stage0041_03:r_bdc546b199c80996.text:
$$アスカ$$
「Fine, that'll do.
　Take care of me from now on, $$ＡＧ$$.」

stage0041_03:r_22c8caf8c08c5119.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Oh...! To drop the honorific like that,
　I must be someone close to you,
　Lady Shikinami!」

stage0041_03:r_96f156e19b53fc09.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「That's the line I wanted to hear!
　Now, my own catchphrase, not to be outdone!」

stage0041_03:r_f42017dfce31dea9.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Ah... that look of scorn feels so good...」
